Necessity N_U = R(full)-R(perp) = +0.011 [0.009,0.012] -- CI excludes 0 only because of tiny bootstrap variance, but the magnitude is 3% of the payload. Noising agrees: removing U_info from the clean value loses only +0.009 (full-into-clean is a 0.000 no-op memorial). So U_info is neither sufficient nor materially necessary.

REFLECTION.overall: L3H1's partner PAYLOAD is LOCALIZED to the 4-token acceptor window (full +0.382 ~= A2 joint), and -- RELATIVE TO the preregistered rank-8 U_info -- is NOT concentrated in that subspace: U_info recovers +0.06, not above an energy-matched random rank-8 (p=0.22); the complement carries ~all (perp +0.37), N_U +0.011. SCOPED CONCLUSION (narrowed): the payload is distributed *relative to U_info*, not distributed in general -- its intrinsic dimensionality is UNMEASURED (a privileged low-rank subspace could still exist in the 504-d complement; would need a rank sweep or an independently-derived acceptor-side U_source). U_info is NOT redefined: it remains the valid DELIVERED donor-side format (C16/C17); A2b shows the same basis is not privileged at the acceptor SOURCE.
